title: Record a landing (commit hash, remote ref, push time, installed build hash) as a typed field of the completion seal instead of prose only, additive and absent on historical seals
outcome: Record a landing (commit hash, remote ref, push time, installed build hash) as a typed field of the completion seal instead of prose only, additive and absent on historical seals
acceptance: A completion can carry one typed landing record — commit hash, remote and branch ref, push time, and the installed build hash when a binary was installed — supplied through the agent words at or before `done` (design review decides the exact word and shape), stored in the seal, and shown by `show` and the completed item's JSON as one field; a seal without it reads and shows "no landing recorded"
Historical seals are read as stored: no backfill, no migration, no import conversion; readiness stays ready on every live store and the change is additive to the seal's shape

The doctor can check, when a local repository is available and the check is requested, that a recorded landing commit exists on the named remote ref; it never fetches by itself and reports absence by name

docs/features/local-work-system.md and docs/shipped.md describe the landing record and the historical caveat; the prose practice (landing notes with commit, gate id and freeze fingerprint) stays valid alongside it

completion.summary: Typed landing record on the completion seal (done --landed/--remote/--branch/--pushed-at/--installed-build, MCP landing, show field), doctor --check-landings, and docs; landed as 75b1884 and installed as build cc145be6c000
